fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) this classification belongs to. Denormalized (mirrors BoQ Cell Remark) so the overlay is filterable by BoQ.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, stored VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped/trimmed). Part of the durable Excel-address identity (survives a re-commit).
fields.label: Sheet Name

fields.description: The source Excel row number this classification annotates (= BOQ Nodes.source_row_number = the committed grid row_number). Durable identity component. A classification is PER-ROW (no col_letter).
fields.label: Excel Row

fields.description: The committed-tier commit_version of the sheet this classification annotates. Anchored to a committed version; identity component.
fields.label: Committed Version

fields.description: The engine/discipline that produced this classification. IN the identity tuple (unlike BoQ Cell Remark) so a second engine's row for the SAME Excel address can coexist as its own current record. v1 is always 'Electrical'.
fields.label: Discipline

fields.description: The rule runner's (classify_line) winning category_id, or blank on ABSTAIN.
fields.label: Rule Category Id

fields.description: The rule runner's confidence band: HIGH / MED / LOW / ABSTAIN.
fields.label: Rule Band

fields.description: The rule runner's post-conflict confidence score (0-1).
fields.label: Rule Score

fields.description: The independent AI voter's category_id (never sees rule-engine output), or blank.
fields.label: AI Category Id

fields.description: The AI voter's self-reported confidence (0-1).
fields.label: AI Confidence

fields.description: The routed EFFECTIVE category on auto-accept (rule==AI consensus). BLANK when routing is 'Needs review' -- a blank final_category_id means route-to-human, it is NEVER a category. Effective = human_category_id if set else final_category_id.
fields.label: Final Category Id

fields.description: The R3d routing verdict for this row.
fields.label: Routing

fields.description: Human-readable explanation of the routing verdict (consensus / weak-consensus / disagreement / mutual-blank).
fields.label: Routing Reason

fields.description: The reviewer's chosen category. When set, it is the effective category (overrides final_category_id). Written IN PLACE on the current record by set_human_verdict -- it does NOT mint a new version (the verdict annotates the same classification run).
fields.label: Human Category Id

fields.description: When the human verdict was recorded.
fields.label: Human Verdict At

fields.description: The reviewer who recorded the human verdict (frappe.session.user).
fields.label: Human Verdict By

fields.description: The rules_electrical.json version that produced rule_*.
fields.label: Rules Version

fields.description: The AI category prompt version (electrical_ai_category_prompt.md header) that produced ai_*.
fields.label: Prompt Version

fields.description: The AI model that produced ai_*.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: A copy of the committed row's description at classification time -- a copy-forward MATCH GUARD (a future copy-forward slice warns when the committed description changed under a classification). NOT part of the unique key; never branched on.
fields.label: Description (guard)

fields.description: Per-(boq, sheet_name, excel_row, committed_version, discipline) classification version. Incremented on re-classify by the write path (freeze-and-supersede, mirroring the pricing/annotation tiers).
fields.label: Category Version

fields.description: Exactly one current classification record per identity tuple. The one-current invariant is enforced by the write path (persist.write_row_categories), NOT this controller (mirrors the pricing/annotation convention).
fields.label: Is Current

fields.description: When this classification record was written. Set by the write path.
fields.label: Classified At
